Production should target Arbitrum One and staging should target Arbitrum Sepolia. Update the network identities, public RPC and explorer endpoints, sequencer routing and submission policy, withdrawal finality and force-inclusion settings, canonical bridge onboarding settings, and WETH/USDC token identities needed for the migration. Preserve unrelated application settings and configuration structure.

content.text:
The production and staging network configurations in `config.json` have been migrated from Ethereum to Arbitrum (Arbitrum One for production, Arbitrum Sepolia for staging):

- **Network Identities & Endpoints**:
  - `production`: Chain ID `42161` (`Arbitrum One`), public RPC `https://arb1.arbitrum.io/rpc`, explorer `https://arbiscan.io`. Deprecated Goerli fallback URL removed.
  - `staging`: Chain ID `421614` (`Arbitrum Sepolia`), public RPC `https://sepolia-rollup.arbitrum.io/rpc`, explorer `https://sepolia.arbiscan.io`. Deprecated Goerli fallback URL removed.
- **Sequencer Routing & Submission Policy**:
  - Set `readRpcUrl`, `writeRpcUrl`, and `sequencerSubmissionUrl` to the respective Arbitrum RPC endpoints.
  - Enabled sequencer submission (`sequencerSubmissionOnly: true`) accepting `eth_sendRawTransaction`.
  - Configured retryable sequencer submission errors (`nonce too low`, `transaction underpriced`).
- **Withdrawal Finality & Force-Inclusion**:
  - Set `withdrawalsToEthereumAreInstant: false`.
  - Configured `challengeWindowBlocks` to `45818` (standard ~7 day fraud proof window) and `forceIncludePeriodBlocks` to `5760` (~24 hour sequencer bypass force-inclusion delay).
- **Canonical Bridge Onboarding**:
  - Updated `preferredRoute` to `canonicalBridge` with `canonicalBridge.enabled: true`.
- **Token Identities**:
  - `production`: Updated native `USDC` (`0xaf88d065e77c8cC2239327C5EDb3A432268e5831`), bridged `USDC.e` (`0xFF970A61A04b1cA14834A43f5dE4533eBDDB5CC8`), and `WETH` (`0x82aF49447D8a07e3bd95BD0d56f35241523fBab1`).
  - `staging`: Updated `WETH` (`0x980B62Da83eFf3D4576C647993b0c1D7faf17c73`) and testnet `USDC` (`0x75faf114eafb1BDbe2F0316DF893fd58CE46AA4d`).
- **Unrelated Settings**: Preserved `application`, `wallet`, `retry`, and common contract configurations (`multicall3`).
